title: 24 August 1963: Live: Gaumont Cinema, Bournemouth
content:
24 August 1963 was the last of The Beatles’ six consecutive dates in the English seaside town of Bournemouth.

They played two houses on each night. Also on the bill were Tommy Quickly and Billy J Kramer and the Dakotas.

The Beatles stayed at the Palace Court hotel on each night of the residency.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024
